'''Sando's Boys''' was the name of the group of individuals&mdash;more or less permanent members&mdash;that followed the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Sando (smuggler)|Sando]]. The majority of the members were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and Sando made sure that they were well versed in hand-to-hand and ranged combat, as well as carrying [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
